resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or equivalent open-source DFT code)

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave pseudopotential DFT code. The agent may use ABINIT, GPAW, etc., as long as it provides LDA capabilities.

A suitable LDA Vanderbilt ultrasoft pseudopotential for Si can be obtained from the SSSP library or the Quantum ESPRESSO pseudopotential repository. Example: Si.pbe-n-rrkjus_psl.0.1.UPF (with appropriate LDA functional).
